objective: Produce the design brief stating category, top tasks, audience, constraints and the visual-direction hypothesis so the design stages have a shared basis despite the missing PRD.
context: Stage design-brief of product-design. Inputs are hypotheses (A-001..A-008).
constraints: Label every persona and finding HYPOTHESIS where no research exists.
acceptance_criteria: Brief names category, three top tasks per role and the accessibility target.
Every claim about users is marked F, A or H with a ledger id.
verification: ux-auditor reads the brief and checks each user claim has a ledger id.
